# Role Reads Reference

Complete reference for the `glassfrog roles` command — the org-wide role list and single-role read.

## Overview

`glassfrog roles` is a single command with an optional positional id:

- With no positional, it **lists** the organization's roles.
- With one positional `ROLE_ID`, it **reads that role by id**.

More than one positional is rejected as a usage error with no API call. The command is the whole-organization role surface, distinct from the token-scoped `glassfrog me roles`.

Codebase enrichment skipped — not attempted. This reference is based on the interface contracts only.

## `glassfrog roles` — list

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog roles [--parent ROLE_ID] [--person ACTOR_ID] [--has-subroles[=true|false]] [--tag TAG] [--first-page] [--per-page N] [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

### List flags

These flags are rejected with a usage error when a `ROLE_ID` is also given.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--parent` | string | — | Filter to roles within a parent role (`parent_role_id`, `role_…`). |
| `--person` | string | — | Filter to roles assigned to a person/agent (`person_id`, `per_`/`agt_…`). |
| `--has-subroles` | bool (tri-state) | omitted = all | Filter by whether a role has sub-roles. Sent only when the flag is present: `--has-subroles`/`=true` → roles with sub-roles; `=false` → leaf roles; omit for all. |
| `--tag` | string | — | Filter by tag name (`tag`, case-insensitive). |
| `--first-page` | bool | false | Fetch only the first page and signal if more exist (see [Completeness signalling](#completeness-signalling)). |
| `--per-page` | int | API max | Page size for the walk. The API owns the valid range. |

### List output

Output is rendered in the resolved format (see [Output formats](#output-formats)). Every format fetches the same roles — the format changes rendering, not fetch depth. By default the list walks to completion; `--first-page` limits all formats to one page.

**`full`** — one block per role, blocks separated by a blank line:

```
<Role Name> (role_0123…)
  Purpose: <purpose | (no purpose set)>
  Domains:
    - <domain description>
  Accountabilities:
    - <accountability description>
```

Each section header always renders. When a section has entries, they are listed one per `    - <description>` line. When a section is empty, the header is followed by a single standalone indented `    (none)` line (no leading `-`):

```
  Domains:
    (none)
```

**`compact`** — one line per role: id first, then double-space-separated `key=value` fragments:

```
role_0123…  <Role Name>  fillers=<N>  subroles=<yes|no>
```

**`json` / `yaml`** — the aggregated document `{ "data": [ <role>, … ] }`, where each role's bytes are preserved verbatim across the walk. Only the `data` envelope is synthesized; per-page `meta` is dropped.

**Empty result** (the org has no roles, or none match the filters): under `full`/`compact`, stdout is exactly `No roles.` and the command exits `0`. Structured formats emit `{"data": []}` (never `null`).

## `glassfrog roles <ROLE_ID>` — single read

### Synopsis

```
glassfrog roles <ROLE_ID> [--include a,b,…] [--base-url URL] [-o FORMAT]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROLE_ID` | string | required for single read | The role to read (`role_…`). Not validated locally; the API resolves it (an unknown/malformed id → `404`). |

### Single-read flag

This flag is rejected with a usage error when no `ROLE_ID` is given.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--include` | string (comma-separated) | — | Related resources to embed inline (`?include=`). Validated locally before any request; an unsupported value is a fail-fast usage error. |

### `--include` targets

| Value | Embedded resource |
|---|---|
| `assignments` | The role's assignments (actors filling the role). |
| `subroles` | The role's immediate sub-roles. |
| `parent_role` | The role's parent role. |
| `policies` | The role's policies. |
| `notes` | The role's notes. |
| `skills` | The role's skills (summaries only; full content via a future skills read). |

### Single-read output

**`full`** — the role block, followed by one guarded section per requested `--include` resource. A section is omitted entirely when not requested. When requested, each is a header line followed by one `    - <entry>` line per item, or a single standalone indented `    (none)` line when empty (no leading `-`). `Parent role` is the exception: it renders inline on the header line.

```
  Assignments:
    - <actor name> (per_… | agt_…)
    (none)
  Subroles:
    - <subrole name> (role_…)
    (none)
  Parent role: <parent name> (role_…)
  Parent role: (none — anchor role)
  Policies:
    - <policy title>
    (none)
  Notes:
    - <note title>
    (none)
  Skills:
    - <skill name> (summary; full content via skills read)
    (none)
```

(Each block shows the populated form and, below it, the empty form — only one renders per section.)

**`json` / `yaml`** — the API's `{data: RoleDetail}` body verbatim: no field dropped, no number coerced.

## Projection fields

### Role (list and single)

| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| Name | Role name; rendered with the id, e.g. `<Role Name> (role_0123…)`. |
| Purpose | Rendered as `(no purpose set)` when absent. |
| Domains | List of domain descriptions; `(none)` when empty. |
| Accountabilities | List of accountability descriptions; `(none)` when empty. |
| Fillers | Actors filling the role (`compact` list projection shows `fillers=<N>`). |
| Sub-roles presence | `compact` list shows `subroles=<yes|no>`. |

### RoleDetail (single read, embedded resources)

Embedded fields are present only when the matching `--include` value is requested.

| Resource | Projected fields |
|---|---|
| Assignments | Actor name and id (`per_…` / `agt_…`). |
| Subroles | Sub-role name and id (`role_…`). |
| Parent role | Parent name and id; `(none — anchor role)` when the role is the anchor. |
| Policies | Policy title. |
| Notes | Note title. |
| Skills | Skill name (summary only). |

## Completeness signalling

A partial list is never silently presented as complete. Completeness is signalled the same way in every format — via a note on **stderr**, never an in-band `meta`.

| Situation | Behaviour | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| Default (full walk) | Walks every page and renders the complete set. | 0 |
| `--first-page`, more pages exist | Renders the first page; writes to stderr: `note: more roles exist than shown; re-run without --first-page to fetch all` | 0 |
| Mid-walk failure | Renders roles gathered so far; writes to stderr: `note: result is incomplete — <cause>; the roles shown are a partial set` | non-zero |

stdout carries only the rendered result (or `No roles.`); all diagnostics and incompleteness notes go to stderr.

## Output formats

Inherited persistent root flags, read by cobra inheritance:

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--base-url URL` | Override the API base URL (top rung of the base-URL precedence chain). |
| `-o`, `--output FORMAT` | `full` (default), `compact`, `json`, or `yaml`. Resolution chain: flag → `GLASSFROG_OUTPUT` → `.glassfrogrc output` → `full`. |

The raw API envelope is never emitted under a human format (`full`/`compact`).

## Exit codes and errors

Errors go to **stderr**; the exit code is the category from the Exit-Code Convention. Every message names the cause and a next step, and never includes the token.

| Condition | Exit | stderr message |
|---|---|---|
| Roles listed / role read (incl. empty list) | 0 | — (result on stdout; incompleteness note on stderr when applicable) |
| No usable token | 2 | "not authenticated — run `glassfrog auth login`" |
| Unreadable / malformed credential file | 1 | names the path — "fix or remove the malformed `.glassfrogrc`" |
| Unknown/forbidden role id, or other non-2xx (4xx/5xx) | 3 / 4 / 5 | names the HTTP status + extracted detail; per-class next step (permission: "check the token's access"; rate-limit: "retry later") |
| Could not reach the wire | 6 | names the transport failure + host — "check network access and the base URL" |
| 2xx body did not match the expected shape | 1 | "the API response did not match the expected shape — may be an API change; report it" |
| Malformed paging mid-walk | 1 | "the API returned malformed pagination — partial set shown" |
| Base-URL configuration error | 2 | names the malformed base URL + source |
| Invalid `--output` selector | 2 | names the bad format value + the four valid names |
| Unsupported `--include` value | 2 | names the unsupported value + the supported set; no request sent |
| `--include` without an id, a list filter with an id, `--has-subroles` with a non-bool value, or >1 positional | 2 | names the misuse (e.g. "--include applies to a single role; pass a role id") |

Exit codes by category: `0` success, `1` runtime error, `2` usage error, `3` API error, `4` permission error, `5` rate-limited, `6` network unavailable.
